title: Framework Agreement for Minor Highway Works (Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council and Test Valley Borough Council)
description:
Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council in partnership with Test Valley Borough Council are seeking expressions of interest from relevant suppliers to tender for their Framework Contract for Minor Highway Works. Please note that this Framework contract covers the Borough of Basingstoke and Deane and the Borough of Test Valley, both in Hampshire.\\\\r\\r\r
\\\\r\\r\r
The contract will operate for a period of 3 years with a 1 year option to extend, and is expected to commence from 01/09/2019 and cover Highway Civil Engineering projects ranging anywhere from a few hundred pounds up to £75,000.00.\\\\r\\r\r
\\\\r\\r\r
Typical works let through this contract are of a Highway Civil Engineering nature and range from the construction of drop kerbs and small footway links to the implementation of additional parking projects and neighbourhood regeneration schemes.  Any one project could comprise elements of traffic management, site clearance, fencing, drainage, earthworks, kerbing, macadam surfacing and / or street furniture installation; hence suitable bidders will be those with experience of all of these areas.\\\\r\\r\r
\\\\r\\r\r
This Framework contract comprises submitted rates against each individual item listed within the Contract Schedule of Items. Bidders must be able to supply every item listed within Document 5 Appendix 1 Schedule of Works.\\\\r\\r\r
Any contractor wishing to be considered for appointment onto this framework agreement must complete and return the PAS 91 prequalification questionnaire. Responses to the prequalification questionnaire will be used to draw up a restricted list of companies invited to participate further in the procurement process. The number of companies to be invited to tender as a result of this opportunity notice will be restricted to a minimum of 5 and maximum of 7 suppliers (this will only be exceeded where multiple suppliers have the same total score) with a total of up to 5 suppliers appointed to the framework contract.\\\\r\\r\r
The Council is utilising an electronic tendering tool to manage this procurement and communicate with suppliers.  Accordingly, there will be no hard copy documents issued to bidders and all communications with the Council, including the submission of Supplier Responses, will be conducted via the ProContract system, which can be accessed using the following link:	\\\\r\\r\r
http://sebp.due-north.com\\\\r\\r\r
\\\\r\\r\r
For the information of Tenderers, advice on accessing the system is available using the following link: https://supplierhelp.due-north.com   \\\\r\\r\r
If you need further assistance using the ProContract system please contact the PROACTIS support team or Email ProContractSuppliers@proactis.com OR log a support call directly using the following link: http://proactis.kayako.com/procontractv3/Core/Default/Index \\\\r\\r\r
Please note expressions of interest must be registered before 11:00:00 Monday 13 May 2019. \\\\r\\r\r
Completed prequalification questionnaires and supporting information should be returned no later than 12:00:00 on Monday 13 May 2019.

title: Guide to Making Historic Buildings More Energy Efficient for Test Valley Borough Council
description:
The Council is seeking to produce a bespoke, non-technical guidance note for the owners and occupiers of heritage buildings and properties located in conservation areas to assist them in understanding what measures are appropriate to improve their energy efficiency and to contribute to renewable and low carbon energy generation. It will also be a useful source of information for other parties with an interest in these maters including Council officers and members, Parish/Town councils and professional agents.

This new guidance should be in accordance with all national and local policy and guidance, and the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and should be a robust document to support, guide, and assist in the management of the Borough's heritage buildings to balance the requirement to conserve and enhance their significance with responding to the climate emergency.

Further information is available at https://uk.eu-supply.com/app/rfq/rwlentrance_s.asp?PID=85549&B=UK

title: TENDER FOR THE SUPPLY AND/OR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION & MAINTENANCE OF SIGNAGE ACROSS HAMPSHIRE UNDER A FRAMEWORK AGREEMENT
description:
Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council (the council) are seeking to commission competent and experienced contractor(s) for the provision of signage at various site locations throughout Hampshire. The Council is acting as Lead Authority on behalf of the authorities listed below:  \r
â€¢	Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council\r
â€¢	East Hampshire District Council\r
â€¢	Eastleigh Borough Council\r
â€¢	Fareham Borough Council\r
â€¢	Gosport Borough Council\r

â€¢	Hart District Council\r

â€¢	Isle of Wight Council\r
â€¢	New Forest Borough Council\r
â€¢	Portsmouth City Council\r
â€¢	Rushmoor Borough Council\r
â€¢	Southampton City Council\r
â€¢	Test Valley Borough Council\r
â€¢	Winchester City Council\r
\r
Other authorities that are part of this process comprise:\r
\r
â€¢	Town and Parish Councils within Hampshire\r
â€¢	Junior, Primary and Secondary Schools in the Hampshire County Council local authority area, (private schools are not included in the Framework).\r
\r
The main objective of this invitation to Tender(ITT) is to establish a Framework Contract, potentially with multiple suppliers (however, only 1 supplier will be awarded to each of the four lots which could potentially be the same supplier) to cover the needs of each organisation that uses the framework.\r
\r
The framework will  cover the supply of various types of signage, ranging from very small quantities (one item) to larger orders.  As requirements differ for each organisation, the contract will comprise of 'supply only' and/or 'supply and installation' Lots.  \r
\r
The framework will be split into four Lots as detailed below:\r
\r
Lot 1 	Street Name Plates	Supply Only\r
Lot 2	Street Name Plates	Supply and Installation/maintenance\r
Lot 3	Road Signage (including Directional Signs, Information signs)	Supply Only\r
Lot 4 	Road Signage (including Directional Signs, Information signs)	Supply and Installation/maintenance\r
\r
The Councils intents to award only one supplier to each Lot, however, tenderers can bid for one or more Lots; though each Lot will be evaluated separately and response documents must be provided for each lot that the tenderer is responding to. Therefore, the potential successful tenderer could be appointed to more than one lot.\r
